data.name: Mezzanine by La Zebra, an SLH Hotel
data.address: km 4.1, Carr. Tulum-Boca Paila, Zona Hotelera Tulum, Zona Hotelera, 77780 Tulum, Q.R., Mexico
data.description:
Next to Las Palmas Beach on the Caribbean Sea, this chic hotel in thatched-roof buildings is 2 km from the Mayan ruins at Tulum, and 8 km from swimming at the Gran Cenote cavern.
The 9 airy rooms are warmly decorated, and offer minibars, free Wi-Fi and safes. Upgraded rooms add sea views and mezzanine sitting areas. The 2 airy suites feature coffeemakers, rainfall showers, designer toiletries, and balconies with sea views. Room service is available.
There's an open-air beachfront Thai restaurant, a bar, an outdoor pool and a spa. Children age 16 and over are welcome. Minimum-stay rules may apply. Breakfast and parking are available.
